description: Edit an existing AI package resource of a video in one language, like the dashboard editor — free. Quiz: send `questions` (the WHOLE new list, 1 to 10 questions, 2 to 5 options each, read it first with panda_get_ai_resource_content) and/or `quiz_settings`. Mind map: `mindmap_edits` (replace an excerpt that exists in one topic only) and/or `mindmap_settings`. eBook: `ebook_edits` (replace an excerpt that exists once in the text), `cover` and/or `ebook_config` (style, logo); the eBook is then recomposed from its text (manual formatting done in the dashboard editor may be lost; images stay) and the new PDF is ready in about 1 minute. Legacy resources (old package) and uploaded PDF eBooks can't be edited. Returns {video_id, resource, lang, saved, changes}; read the result with panda_get_ai_resource_content.

ebook_config.description: eBook: style that changes (layout, fonts, colors, format, logo)

header_footer.description: Header and footer on the pages

logo_key.description: Logo: the logo_key returned by panda_get_ai_ebook_upload_url (kind=logo) after the file was sent; null removes the logo

mindmap_edits.description: Mind map: text replacements in topics

find.description: Excerpt of the CURRENT text, exactly as it appears once

replace.description: Text that goes in its place

questions.description: Quiz: the whole new list of questions (replaces the current one)

options.description: 2 to 5 options, correct=true on the right one(s)

name: panda_update_ai_resource
title: Update AI Resource
